BAND_MEANS.PROTECTED: You follow them, or they’re one of your own accounts. Nothing will ever add them to a list.
BAND_MEANS.CONNECTED: 3 or more of the people you follow follow them, or 1 does and they have 5,000 followers or more.
BAND_MEANS.PERIPHERAL: 1 or 2 of the people you follow follow them, or they follow you.
BAND_MEANS.NOTABLE: No connection to you, but they have 10,000 followers or more, or post a lot to a real audience.
BAND_MEANS.UNKNOWN: Nobody you follow follows them, and they don’t follow you. Most of any pile-on.
